caseName: Portland General Electric Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Portland General Electric Co. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Erskine Wood for petitioner., Mr. Alfred A. Hampson for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law. § 8 (a), Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 940), 28 U. S. C., § 350.
